items.raw_excerpt: Month after month, 51-year-old Saina Banu set aside earnings from her work processing prawns for export. By 2025, she had managed to save Rs 45,000 (~USD 470)—money she spent building a barrier of sandbags around her home in the Kuttanad wetlands in Thottappally, along Kerala's Alappuzha coast.
